description: This file defines the SaveWorkShiftController class, which manages the preparation of Vue.js components related to work shift creation and editing within the OrangeHRM system. It uses traits and services to fetch configuration data and sets up components with appropriate properties based on request parameters.

classes.name: SaveWorkShiftController
classes.description: Controller class for handling the save work shift functionality, determining whether to load an existing shift for editing or prepare defaults for a new shift.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the Vue component with appropriate properties based on whether a work shift ID is provided in the request, used to either edit an existing shift or create a new one.
